title: pvCountCellVertices
body:
## pvCountCellVertices

Adds a cell array (default name "Vertex Count") with the number of points of each cell, e.g. 3 for triangles, 8 for hexahedra and the point count of polygons and polyhedra. Use it to check mixed meshes or threshold cells by type-like size.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Higher-order cells count their mid-edge nodes too (e.g. 10 for a quadratic tetrahedron).
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CountCellVertices`. Identity: `filters/CountCellVertices`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |

| `VerticesArrayName` | This is the name of the array in the output containing the vertex counts. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
